decision.target: multires ladder NOP (nop_hard / nop_graded / negative / conflict = NOP; any other available row = TRADE)
SL before TP when held from here (or negative at the forced flat), engine replay

remaining_sigma.target: net(hold to TP / SL / forced flat) - net(close now), per unit / position sigma
remaining_sigma.mask: every available positioned visit of this side

decision.target: SL before TP when held from here (or negative at the forced flat), engine replay

remaining_sigma.target: net(hold to TP / SL / forced flat) - net(close now), per unit / position sigma
remaining_sigma.mask: every available positioned visit of this side

gene_map.open_margin: quantile(best predicted net over side x cell, calibration flat rows, 1 - open_rate)
gene_map.close_margin: -quantile(predicted remaining value, calibration-block positioned visits, close_rem_rate)
gene_map.close_p: quantile(calibrated P(SL first), calibration-block positioned visits, 1 - close_p_rate)
gene_map.nop_veto: quantile(calibrated pNOP, calibration flat rows, 1 - nop_veto_rate)
gene_map.positioned_visits: the round-0 INNER_A exit visits (expert trajectory + exploration positions): strategy-free
gene_map.frozen: on the calibration block before the search; recorded in the strategy doc (gene_map)
gene_map.feasibility_probe: corners of the continuous genes + the q-max point; no point with >= 2.0 trades/week and >= 1 agent close -> STRATEGY_SPACE_INFEASIBLE

strategy.rule: flat: per side the cell with the highest predicted net; open the better side when its predicted net > open_margin and (veto kept) pNOP <= nop_veto; positioned: CLOSE when predicted remaining < -close_margin OR calibrated P(SL first) > close_p (optimal stopping), then reverse when allow_reverse and the open rule picks the other side

optimizer.constraint: Deb constraint domination: >= 2 trades/week (period average) and the env rules

strategy.choice: the arm's fitness variant picks the frozen point among the valid non-dominated (Sharpe, DD) points; ties -> lower max DD
strategy.early_close_rule: owner 2026-10-25 (pre-registered before any audit number was read): early close is indispensable; with strategy.require_early_close a point that never closes voluntarily on the calibration block (agent closes = 0) is DEGENERATE_NO_EARLY_CLOSE and not selectable; it stays in the archive
strategy.costs: inside the targets: every predicted net is the engine's net result (spread, slippage, commission, financing)

visitation.round0: expert trajectory + exploration positions (visited STATES only, never labels)
visitation.rounds: 1..3: the C2 policy at the visitation strategy frozen on INNER_A (closer rows appended, closers refitted)
visitation.openers_and_nop: fitted once in round 0 (their rows are every eligible flat row; visitation does not change them)

inputs.hours_held: (open time of bar b + 1 h - open time of the fill bar) / 1 h / 24

closer_order_geometry.sigma_entry: the decision sigma the engine used to set this order's levels (Position.sigma)
closer_order_geometry.causality: computed after bar b from the open order's own levels and close[b]; nothing after b enters
closer_order_geometry.network_input: closers: recipe window (+) the nine agent-state slots as constant zeros (as C2) (+) these four values; openers / NOP: as C2
closer_order_geometry.forbidden: any other state slot for any specialist (balance, equity, PnL history, entries count, agent outputs, can_enter, ...); geometry on openers or NOP
